meaning_of_mixed: Different source libraries combined in one searchable corpus; distinct from BM25+dense hybrid ranking.
constraints: Primary totals are 300 unique question intents; near duplicates stay in the same split.
Paired reruns retain query_id and split, never increase the independent sample denominator.
Report separate and mixed results, per-library/per-type results and paired change separately.
Use the same default strategy/model/tokenizer/retrieval settings across scopes; no oracle answer-source filters.
Paired interference cases retain the same required facts in both scopes; valid alternative supporting sources are relabeled before inspecting retrieval output.
Questions whose answerability changes after mixing are cross-library coverage cases, not pure interference pairs.
D does not enter development scope or influence tuning.
All cases use the same 12000-character cumulative request/response/host-read budget.
Optional aggregate uses predeclared 70% separate and 30% mixed weights and never substitutes for disaggregated results.
30% applies to the 100/200 primary unique questions; paired diagnostic reruns remain separate and are excluded from that share and aggregate.
supersedes: question-allocation-v2.json: 40% mixed allocation replaced by user-confirmed 30%; four mixed category proportions retained
